scope: Twenty Bebop theme assets. Drone wisps stay subtle; no Drone ribbons or decorative notes on other subjects.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent raster asset for Music Practice. A bebop metronome: a slim tapering pyramid metronome case in glossy midnight-blue lacquer, its edges trimmed in polished saxophone brass, a cream front face with a vertical row of short black tick marks like the edge of a piano keyboard (no numbers), a thin red band across the lower case, on a short stepped ink-black plinth with two small brass feet. Seen exactly straight on from the front, perfectly symmetrical, standing upright and filling the canvas top to bottom with a small margin. There is NO pendulum, rod or weight anywhere. Near the bottom of the face, centred left-to-right, a round brass pivot cap like a saxophone key pad sits exactly at 50% of the width and 83% of the height. Bebop jazz illustration in the manner of a 1950s modern-jazz record sleeve and a late-night jazz club: deep midnight blue and ink black, warm cream, gleaming saxophone brass, a soft amber spotlight glow and a single accent of club-sign red, bold flat colour shapes with crisp edges and a fine halftone-dot texture in the shadows, a few small four-point stars. Cool, swinging, a little playful, simple and readable. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame or border unless the prompt asks for one. Fully transparent background. Canvas portrait 2:3, equivalent to 800x1200. Pivot is centered x=50%, y=83.33%. Keep its round centre precise and readable.
assets.note: Step 1 (draw first). The app rotates the pendulum over this one about the pivot. Ask for (400, 1000) in an 800×1200 canvas, then measure where it really is in the delivered file and record it.
assets.processing: Preserve generated illustration and alpha; clear imperceptible 1/255 alpha noise; crop transparent side margins on narrow layers only; fit without distortion into the measured PNG canvas and export lossless WebP.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept.
